site.name: Annie C Mine
overview: Annie C Mine is a named historic gold-mine locality in Chaffee County's Free Gold Mining District, preserved on federal topographic mapping near Buena Vista.

timeline.text: Annie C was established as a named mine locality in the Free Gold district and was later retained on U.S. Geological Survey topographic mapping of the Buena Vista West quadrangle.

moreHistory: Available records support Annie C as a gold-associated mine locality in the Free Gold Mining District, but dependable operator, production, and detailed chronology records have not been recovered.
The mapped mine location provides a stable identification point without making claims about present-day condition or surviving workings.
